```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


# Load plan

```{r}
fs <- list.files("R", full.names = T)
lapply(fs, function(x) source(x))

```

# Run the processing

```{r}
drake::make(plan, verbose = 2)

vis_drake_graph(plan)

```

# Access targets

```{r}
loadd(CoRR.addABX)
loadd(P188.addABX)
loadd(TCC.full)
loadd(DO.combined)

# loadd(P188)
# loadd(ionames2)
```


# Save

```{r}
out.dir <- file.path("T:", "Labs", "Spakowicz", "ppiio", "data", "derived", Sys.Date())


write.csv(CoRR.addABX, file.path(out.dir, "CoRR4684_formatted.csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(P188.addABX, file.path(out.dir, "P188_formatted.csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(TCC.full, file.path(out.dir, "TCC000138_formatted.csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(DO.combined, file.path(out.dir, "CombinedDO_formatted.csv"), row.names = F)
```
